scope: Book I VIII-XIV including closing nodes; historical reference, not chart interpretation
transcription_policy: Modernized spellings in prose/catalogues; preserve historical taxonomy and listed ambiguities. Not botanical/mineral identity resolution or medical advice. Raw term/face integer lists retain printed discrepancies.

astronomy.appearance: Highest planet between Jupiter and firmament; pale, wan, leaden or ashy; not bright or sparkling.

dignity.detriment: Not explicitly listed in this planetary chapter; do not infer an explicit source statement from opposite domiciles.

planets.nature: Diurnal, cold and dry, melancholic, earthly, masculine; greater Infortune, author of solitariness, malevolent.

manners.well: Profound imagination; severe acts; reserved words; sparing in speech and giving; patient labour; grave argument; studious and solicitous in acquiring worldly goods; austere actions.
manners.ill: Envious, covetous, jealous, mistrustful, timorous, sordid, outwardly dissembling, sluggish, suspicious, stubborn, contemptuous of women, a concealed liar, malicious, murmuring, never content and ever repining.

body.general: Middle stature; cold/dry body; pale, swarthy or muddy complexion; little black downward-looking eyes; broad forehead; black or dark rough hair; large ears; hanging brows; thick lips and nose; sparse beard; unpleasant countenance; head forward or stooping; broad, sometimes crooked shoulders; short lank belly; lean short thighs; ill-shaped knees/feet, sometimes striking together.
body.oriental: Shorter stature but decent and well composed.
body.latitude_and_station: Wanting latitude: leaner. Great latitude: fatter or fleshier. South latitude: fleshier but quick in motion. North latitude: hairy and much flesh. First station: a little fat. Second station: fat, ill-favoured and weak; Lilly tells the reader to observe this last station distinction in the other planets.

planets.illnesses: Right-ear and teeth impediments; quartan agues from cold/dry/melancholic distempers; leprosies, rheums, consumptions, black jaundice, palsies, tremblings, vain fears, fantasies, dropsy, hand/foot gout, apoplexies, dog-hunger, excessive hemorrhoidal flux. Ruptures qualified by Scorpio or Leo and an ill aspect with Venus.
planets.colours_savours: Sour, bitter, sharp; dark/ashy colour occurs in appearance and stone descriptions, not a separate numeric colour code.
beasts: creeping creatures said to breed from putrefaction in earth, water or ruins
planets.weather: Cloudy, dark, obscure, cold and hurtful air; thick black condensed clouds. Further treatment promised elsewhere.
planets.age: Decrepit old men, fathers and grandfathers, with analogous age in plants/trees/creatures.
planets.countries: Late authors are credited with Bavaria, Saxony, Stiria, Romandiola, Ravenna, Constantia, Ingoldstad.
planets.extra: The herb-gathering account is explicitly reported as ancient practice: face east in Saturn's hour, preferably in an angle, then lists Ascendant, tenth or eleventh, Moon applying by trine or sextile. Eleventh is included despite the earlier angular classification; do not silently reclassify it.

astronomy.appearance: Next to Saturn; greatest in appearance except Sun, Moon and Venus; bright, clear, azure.

planets.nature: Diurnal, masculine, temperately hot and moist, airy, sanguine; greater Fortune, author of temperance, modesty, sobriety and justice.

manners.well: Magnanimous, faithful, bashful, honourably aspiring; fair dealing, wishing to benefit all, glorious/honourable/religious deeds; sweet affable conversation; indulgent to wife and children; reverent to aged people; charitable to the poor, liberal, just, wise, prudent, thankful and virtuous, hating sordid actions. The explicit application is Jupiter as a person's significator in a question, or lord of the Ascendant in a nativity, and well dignified.
manners.ill: Wastes patrimony; lets others cheat him; hypocritically religious; tenacious in false religious tenets; ignorant, careless, cold to friends, dull in capacity, schismatic, abasing himself and unnecessarily crouching or stooping.

body.general: Upright tall body; brown/ruddy pleasant complexion; oval or long full fleshy face; high forehead; large grey eyes; soft auburn-brown hair, much beard; large deep belly; strong thighs/legs, long least-comely feet; sober grave speech.
body.oriental: Clearer honey or white/red sanguine complexion, large eyes and fleshier body, usually mole/scar in right foot.
body.occidental: Pure pleasant complexion, shorter stature, light brown/dark flaxen hair; smooth or bald around temple/forehead.

planets.illnesses: Pleurisies; liver and left-ear infirmities; apoplexies; lung inflammation; palpitation/trembling of heart; cramps; backbone pains; veins/ribs and corruption of blood; squinzies; windiness; putrefaction or fevers through excessive blood.
planets.colours_savours: Sweet or well-scented, non-extreme/non-offensive odours; sea-green or blue, purple, ash, mixed yellow and green.
beasts: mild/gentle beasts of great benefit to mankind
planets.weather: Serenity, pleasant/healthful north winds; gentle beams said to allay prior malignant weather.
planets.age: Middle age or full judgement and discretion.
planets.countries: Second climate; Babylon, Persia, Hungary, Spain, Cullen.
planets.extra: Herb-gathering condition: Jupiter powerful by essential OR accidental dignities, Moon in some good aspect, and preferably in one of his dignities. It is not modern efficacy evidence.

astronomy.appearance: After Jupiter; smaller body than Jupiter or Venus; shining fiery sparkling appearance.
astronomy.mean_motion: Printed 31 degrees 27 minutes; retained as a dimensional discrepancy, not silently converted.

triplicity.time: wholly; no day/night split in this clause

planets.nature: Masculine, nocturnal, hot and dry, choleric, fiery; lesser Infortune; author of quarrels, strife and contentions.

manners.well: Invincible in war and courage; unwilling to be exceeded; subject to no reason; bold, confident, immovable, contentious; claims honour, valiant, loves war, hazards himself to perils, unwilling to obey or submit, reports own acts largely; values victory above other things, yet prudent in his own affairs.
manners.ill: Immodest or dishonest prattler; loves slaughter/quarrels, murder and theft; promotes sedition/fights; highway-thief, wavering, traitorous, turbulent, perjured, obscene, rash, inhumane, ungrateful, treacherous, oppressive, ravenous, cheating, furious and violent.

body.general: Middle stature, strong big-boned and lean rather than fat; brown/ruddy/high complexion; round face; red/sandy-flaxen often curling hair; sharp hazel piercing eyes; bold confident face, active and fearless.
body.oriental: Valiant; some white with red complexion; decent tallness and hairy body.
body.occidental: Very ruddy but middling stature; little head, smooth unhaired body, yellow stiff hair and drier humours.

planets.illnesses: Gall and left ear; tertian or pestilent burning fevers; head megrims, carbuncles, plague/sores, burnings, ringworms, blisters, frenzies/sudden mental distempers, yellow jaundice, bloody flux, fistulas; genital wounds/diseases, kidney/bladder stone, scars/smallpox on face, iron injuries, shingles; diseases from excessive choler, anger or passion.
planets.bodily_rule: Gall/choler and left ear in the illness catalogue.
planets.colours_savours: Red, yellow, fiery/shining saffron; bitter, sharp, tongue-burning tastes; choler.
planets.weather: Red clouds, thunder, lightning, fiery impressions and pestilent air, particularly following dryness/fair weather; improper/unwholesome mists.
planets.age: Flourishing youth, from 41 to 56 (the printed age range at page68).
planets.countries: Saromatia, Lombardy, Batavia, Ferraria, Gothland; third climate.
planets.extra: Catalogue membership does not select the occupation of an actual native; the topic-specific significator procedure remains required.

astronomy.appearance: Middle of the seven planets; colour not restated because visible to everyone.
astronomy.period: One year, 365 days and certain hours
astronomy.diurnal_motion: Sometimes 57 arcminutes 16 arcseconds; maximum has over-writing/ink disturbance; printed errata must be kept separate.

planets.nature: Hot and dry but more temperate than Mars; masculine, diurnal; equivalent to a Fortune IF well dignified.

manners.well: Faithful and punctual in promises; desires rule; prudent, excellent judgement, majestic/stately; industrious for honour and patrimony yet willing to part with it; grave few words, confidence and self-command; thoughtful, secret, trustworthy, deliberate, great-hearted yet affable/tractable/humane; loves magnificence and honour, no sordid thoughts.
manners.ill: Arrogant, proud, disdains others, boasts pedigree; purblind sight/judgement, restless, troublesome, domineering, vain, expensive and foolish; no gravity in words or sobriety in acts; wastes patrimony and lives on others' charity while feeling entitled by gentle birth.

body.general: Good large strong body, yellow/saffron complexion, round large forehead, large sharp piercing eyes; well-composed, lovely rather than beautiful; heat, yellowish hair and early baldness, much beard, high ruddy complexion, fleshiness; repeats bountiful/honest/sincere/well-minded/great-hearted/humane traits with spirit, not loquacious.
body.oriental: Only in the figure or its oriental quarter; not before itself at solar rising.
body.occidental: Likewise a figure/quadrant description, distinct from other planets' appearance before or after the Sun.

people: principal local magistrate, even a petty constable where no greater officer exists
planets.illnesses: Facial pimples; palpitation/trembling; brain/heart diseases; tympanies; eye infirmities; cramps; sudden swoonings; mouth diseases and bad breath; catarrhs and rotten fevers.
planets.bodily_rule: Heart, brain, vital spirit, right eye in men and left eye in women.
planets.colours_savours: Yellow/gold, scarlet/clear red, purple according to some; sour and sweet mixture or aromatic, somewhat bitter/stiptic/sharp yet comforting.
stones: pantaure if such a stone exists
planets.weather: According to season: gentle moistening showers in spring; summer extreme heat if with Mars; autumn mists; winter small rain.
planets.countries: Italy, Sicily, Bohemia, Phoenicia, Chaldea; fourth climate.
planets.extra: He rejects the opinion that occupying any of the six northern signs gives the Sun terms; records it to reject it, not to endorse an extra dignity. Solar plant virtues are historical therapeutic/magical assertions, not advice.

astronomy.appearance: Bright/shining; evening star after sunset, morning star before sunrise.
astronomy.latitude_north: Says maximum north/south 2 degrees 2 arcminutes, then reports 8 degrees 36 arcminutes north in February 1643

planets.nature: Feminine, temperately cold and moist, nocturnal, lesser Fortune, author of mirth and jollity; air and water; phlegm with blood, spirit and generative seed.

manners.well: Quiet, not litigious/quarrelsome/wrangling, not vicious; pleasant, neat, spruce, merry in speech/acts, clean clothing; more drinking than gluttony; amorous and often involved in love, zealous affections, musical, enjoys baths, honest merry meetings, masques and plays; easy belief, not given to labour, sociable, cheerful, unsuspicious, virtuous; sometimes suspected with no cause.
manners.ill: Riotous, expensive, sexually loose, disregards reputation, seeks unlawful beds, incest/adultery; fanatic, unreliable and disreputable; spends in taverns/loose company, lazy and careless about life/religion; called atheist/natural man by the source.

body.general: Fair but not tall stature; white somewhat darkened complexion; lovely darkish eyes, round not large face, smooth abundant light-brown hair; attractive mouth/cherry lips, fleshy face, wandering and also steadfast eye descriptions; well-shaped body, neat grooming and dress, cheek dimple and amorous look.
body.oriental: Tends to uprightness/tallness without corpulence or great height; neatly composed, attractive man or woman.
body.occidental: Shorter but decent and comely, liked by all.

professions: sellers of adornments for women's body/face
planets.illnesses: Matrix/generative members; kidneys, belly, back and navel; gonorrhea/running of reins; French or Spanish pox, inordinate-lust disease, priapism, impotence, hernias, diabetes/pining disease.
planets.bodily_rule: Matrix/generative members and related parts in the disease catalogue.
planets.colours_savours: White/milky sky-colour mixed with brown or little green; pleasant, moist, sweet, delectable; unctuous aromatic smells inciting wantonness.
stones: lapis lazuli, with claim of expelling melancholy
planets.weather: Etesias; summer serenity/clear weather, winter rain or snow.
planets.countries: Arabia, Austria, Campania, Vienna, greater Poland, Turing, Parthia, Media, Cyprus; sixth climate.
planets.extra: A friendship list is not given at this location. Do not fill it symmetrically from other planets.

astronomy.appearance: Least planet, dusky silver, rarely visible; text says ever distant above 27 degrees from Sun [retained witness wording].
astronomy.diurnal_motion: Sometimes 1 degree 40 arcminutes; never more; also lists 66,68,70,80,86,100 arcminutes

motion_state.first_station_days: one day, without distinct phase in this clause

planets.nature: Not fixed masculine/feminine: takes either according to conjunction with a masculine/feminine planet. Intrinsically cold/dry/melancholic; good with good, ill with evil; water, mixed humours and animal spirit; author of subtlety, tricks/devices/perjury.

manners.well: Subtle political brain, intellect and cogitation; excellent learned/discreet disputant/logician, eloquent; searches mysteries/learning, sharp/witty, learns without teacher, aims at excellence in every science, travels/sees foreign places, unwearied fancy and occult curiosity, ingenious wonders, divination/secret knowledge; if a merchant, exceptional trade and wealth-making inventions.
manners.ill: Troublesome wit/heretical; tongue and pen against everyone; wastes estate/time on pointless experiments; lies, boasts, prattles, busies himself and carries tales; wicked/necromantic arts; credulous, foolish, inconstant place/opinion, cheating/theft, news-mongering, pretends knowledge without solid learning; idle words, easily perverted verbal divine without judgement.

body.general: Tall straight thin/spare body, high forehead, narrow long face/nose, fair neither black nor grey eyes, thin lips, little beard but abundant dark-brown/black hair, long arms/fingers/hands, olive/chestnut complexion.
body.oriental: Honey/sunburnt complexion; not tall but well-jointed, small eyes/little hair and well-composed, with swarthy complexion and self-serving speech.
body.occidental: Tawny face, lank body, slender limbs, hollow sparkling red/fire eyes, dry frame.
body.association: Any aspect imports the other planet's influence more than in other planets: Saturn heavy, Jupiter temperate, Mars rash, Sun genteel, Venus jesting, Moon shifting. The opening gender rule specifies conjunction, not merely every aspect.

planets.illnesses: Vertigo/lethargy/giddiness, madness/lightness/brain disease, ptisick; stammering/tongue defects; vain imagination, memory defects, hoarseness, dry cough, excessive spittle, head/nose snuffling; hand/foot gout, dumbness, tongue-evil and disorders of fancy/intellect.
planets.bodily_rule: Animal spirit, intellectual faculties and tongue/brain/lungs/memory relations.
planets.colours_savours: New/mixed colours, grey/sky mixture like stock-dove neck, linsey-woolsey; mixed tastes without one name, often subtle/spirit-quickening/penetrating.
beasts: hermaphrodite in the historical mixed-sex catalogue
planets.weather: Windy/stormy/violent/boisterous; rain, hail, lightning, thunder/tempests, earthquakes in hot countries; MUST observe sign and season.
planets.winds: Wind signified by the planet to which he applies.
planets.extra: No separate complete friend/enemy table here; conditional assimilation is not a symmetric friendship matrix.

astronomy.appearance: Nearest planet to Earth; colour treated as commonly known.
astronomy.diurnal_motion: Variable; says never exceeds 15 degrees 2 arcminutes in 24 hours

motion_state.qualification: Always direct; LESS than 13 degrees 10 arcminutes in 24 hours is called equivalent to a retrograde planet. Distinguish analogy from physical motion and from the stated mean including 36 arcseconds.

planets.nature: Feminine, nocturnal, cold, moist and phlegmatic.

manners.well: Composed, soft/tender; loves honest ingenious sciences, searches/delights in novelty; inclined to move home, unsteadfast, concerned with present, timorous, prodigal/easily frightened; peace-loving and wants freedom from cares; if a mechanic, learns many occupations and tries many trades.
manners.ill: Vagabond/idle, hates work, drunken/sottish, lacks spirit/foresight, content to live beggarly/carelessly, satisfied in no condition, good or bad.

body.general: Fair stature, whitish colour, round face, grey somewhat louring eyes, much head/face/body hair, often one eye larger, short fleshy hands and plump/corpulent/phlegmatic body.
body.oriental: No separate oriental corporature paragraph in this chapter.
body.occidental: No separate occidental corporature paragraph in this chapter.
body.eye_qualification: Sun impediment in nativity or question usually indicates blemish in/near eye; succedent impediment is near eye; unfortunate in angles WITH nebulous fixed stars concerns sight. Do not merge cosmetic blemish with vision impairment.

planets.illnesses: Apoplexies, palsy, colic/bellyache, left-side diseases, stones/bladder/generative members, women's menses/liver, dropsy, belly fluxes, cold rheumatic disease/stomach, wrist/foot gout, sciatica, worms, eye rheums/injuries, surfeits, rotten coughs, convulsions, falling sickness, kings-evil, abscesses, smallpox/measles.
planets.bodily_rule: Left eye of men/right eye of women and the other parts explicitly listed under disease.
planets.colours_savours: White, pale yellowish white, pale green, silvery; fresh or tasteless/unripe or brain-moistening flavours.
planets.weather: With Saturn cold air; Jupiter serene; Mars winds/red clouds; Sun according to season; Venus and Mercury showers/winds.
planets.winds: North in Hermetic operation; when strongest in the scheme/lunation, wind according to next applying planet.
planets.extra: Chapter closes with the Head/Tail of Dragon and Lilly's explicitly different experience from the opinion he attributes to the ancients.
